name: paperflow
description: LaTeX completion (commands, packages, BibTeX citations) and interactive Markdown checklist preview for academic writing and task management.

scripts.package-ext: rolldown src/extension.ts -o out/extension.js -f cjs -p node -e vscode -m
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run fmt:check

paperflow.autoSave.description: Automatically save the Markdown document when a task checkbox status is changed.

paperflow.latex.enableCompletion.description: Enable LaTeX command autocompletion in LaTeX files and Markdown math blocks.

paperflow.latex.includeBuiltinCommands.description: Include built-in common LaTeX commands in autocompletion.

paperflow.latex.customCommands.description: Custom LaTeX commands and snippets as key-value pairs (e.g. { "mycmd": "mycmd{${1:x}}" }).

paperflow.latex.loadCommandsFromFiles.description: Automatically scan local .sty/.tex files and TeX Live packages for \newcommand, \DeclareMathOperator, and macro definitions.

paperflow.latex.commandFiles.description: Additional .tex/.sty/.cls files or directories to scan for LaTeX command definitions (relative to workspace root or absolute paths).

paperflow.latex.texliveRoot.description: Root directory of TeX Live installation (e.g. /usr/local/texlive/2026 or C:\texlive\2026). Leave empty to auto-detect.

paperflow.latex.texliveFiles.description: Package names from TeX Live to always scan for command completions (e.g. ["amsmath", "physics"]).

paperflow.latex.showSectionNumbers.description: Display inline hierarchical section numbers (e.g. 1, 1.1, 1.1.1) at the end of \section, \subsection, and \subsubsection lines in LaTeX documents.

commands.title: PaperFlow: Toggle Task on Current Line
